notes.title: Introducing NetStars - VR Goalie Trainer
notes.notes:
Thank you all for the feedback and support with Goalie Challenge VR. After a lot of work with goalies, coaches and USA Hockey, we are excited to announce the most realistic Goalie Simulator and Trainer in the world, NetsStars -

http://store.steampowered.com/app/800670/NetStars__VR_Goalie_Trainer/

notes.title: MoCap and Speed Indicator have arrived!
notes.notes:
We are making progress on our full-featured game including the start of motion capture animation for the skater AI.

In celebration of this milestone, we have updated the base skater in our free version to include one of the motion capture swings.

We have also added a speed indicator to the current version as well as enhanced net pegs brought to you by Wylie Rogers and theWyliePost.com.

Cheers!
Josh

notes.title: Minor bug fixes.
notes.notes:
- Moved in-game pause button from touchpad to menu button.
- Fixed the exploding stick bug.
- Set minimum power on local player mode to prevent bad swings.
- Made UI pointer visible during all menu screens.

notes.title: New Local Shooter Mode!
notes.notes: Now you can settle the score once and for all with the new local shooter mode. Play against friends, with one as the goalie in VR and the other as the shooter using an Xbox or Steam controller.

notes.title: Player Feedback Edition
notes.notes:
Thanks for all of the feedback and patience. We are excited to announce that we are now working on a full-featured goalie sim game. There are tons of fun features, challenges, locations and skill events we are looking forward to bringing to all of you this fall.

In the meantime, check out the new and improved Goalie Challenge VR -

New features include:
- Auto-adjust goalie stick height
- Active-adjust leg pads
- Improved puck physics
- Improved stick physics
- Goal location indicator
- Shot map

Keep the feedback coming.

notes.title: Fresh Build
notes.notes:
Thanks for all the early and positive input. 

We have made the following updates -
- New Added Torso.
- New Added Helmet.
- Destroy puck before new shot.
- Adjusted puck timing.
- Fixed the goalie puck shot, for the most part. Still could use a little work though.

Please keep the input coming.

Cheers!
